item.title: Qatar Condemns Zamfara Village Attack, Condoles With Nigeria Over ‘Dozens Dead’
item.description: Qatar condemns Zamfara village attack whlch left dozens dead, expresses condolences to Nigeria, hopes for safe return of abducted women, children.

item.title: Shettima: Nigeria Would Have Hit N1,000/$1 Within Weeks Without CBN’s Intervention
item.description: Vice President Kashim Shettima says reforms stabilised Nigeria’s economy, adding CBN intervention prevented the naira from hitting N1,000 per dollar.

item.title: Ghana Renames Kotoka International Airport After 60 Years, Sparking National Debate
item.description: Ghana renames Kotoka International Airport to Accra International Airport, igniting debate over history, democracy and legacy of the 1966 coup.

item.title: Court Places AMNI Under Administration Over $2.6 Million Debt, Appoints Sam Aiboni
item.description: AMNI declared unable to pay $2.6 million debt; court appoints administrator to oversee company assets and operations.

item.title: Severe Water And Power Shortages Paralyse Social, Commercial Life Across Niger State
item.description: Persistent water and electricity outages in Niger state have crippled homes, businesses, and daily life for over two weeks.

item.title: FG Files Fresh 12-Count Forgery, Impersonation Case Against Senior Lawyer Mike Ozekhome
item.description: Mike Ozekhome, Ponfa Useni charged with forging Nigerian passport to claim London property, prompting fresh federal prosecution.

item.title: Senegal Prime Minister Seeks Harsher Anti-LGBT Law Doubling Prison Terms
item.description: Senegal PM proposes doubling prison terms for same-sex relations, escalating anti-LGBT laws amid regional human rights concerns.

item.title: Japan Plans Missile Deployment On Yonaguni Island By 2031 Amid Taiwan Tensions
item.description: Japan plans missile deployment on Yonaguni Island by 2031, strengthening defence amid rising tensions over Taiwan and China.

item.title: Archbishop Ndagoso Elected President Of Catholic Bishops Conference Of Nigeria
item.description: Most Rev. Matthew Ndagoso becomes CBCN president, succeeding Archbishop Ugorji, with key leadership positions also announced.

item.title: Sokoto Governor Launches N1 Billion Ramadan Feeding Programme To Support Vulnerable Residents
item.description: Sokoto’s N1 billion Ramadan programme will provide 34,000 daily meals across 170 centres for vulnerable residents.
